description: Import and Export Control Department - Import and Exports (Control) Regulations No. 1 of 2019 Effective from 28th January 2019
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister under the Imports and Exports (Control) Act, establishing new vehicular exhaust emission standards and safety measures/standards for motor vehicles imported into Sri Lanka.
